Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.

entry.content: ... that the Upper Chehalis people adopted horses widely after their introduction, becoming known as "equestrian" compared to their coastal neighbors?

entry.content: ... that an official investigation found the Fukushima nuclear accident was foreseeable and preventable?

entry.title: Arne Slettebak (Wikipedia — did you know?)

entry.title: Green Bay Packers and Seattle Seahawks (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that even though the Green Bay Packers and Seattle Seahawks have only played each other 24 times, 4 of those games have come in the playoffs?

entry.content: ... that Amrita Sher-Gil painted a portrait of Helen Chaman Lall without expecting a fee?
